ex: Woven kevlar is tough enough to be bulletproof.
The woven words of the sonnet were deep and moving.

senses.d: A cloth formed by weaving. It only stretches in the bias directions (between the warp and weft directions), unless the threads are elastic.
ex: A factory that makes cotton and other wovens.

ety.text: Past participle of tessere. Cognate with Piedmontese tëssù.
From tejer (“to weave”) + -ido. Compare English tissue.
Past participle of tecer (“to weave”), from Old Galician-Portuguese tecer, from Latin texere (“to weave”). Cognate of texto (“text”).
